# ATS Optimization Rules

## Formatting Requirements (STRICT)

### ✅ ALLOWED
- Single-column layout only
- Standard fonts (Arial, Calibri, Times New Roman)
- Simple bullet points (•, -, *)
- Bold and italic text
- Hyperlinks
- Standard section headers

### ❌ FORBIDDEN
- Tables (`\begin{tabular}`)
- Images/graphics (`\includegraphics`)
- Multi-column layouts (`\begin{multicol}`)
- Color boxes (`\colorbox`)
- Custom headers/footers
- Text boxes
- Icons or logos

## Keyword Optimization

1. **Mirror Job Description**: Use exact keywords from posting
2. **Industry Terms**: Include standard terminology
3. **Acronyms Both Ways**: "Application Programming Interface (API)" first, then "API"
4. **Skill Variations**: Include both "JavaScript" and "JS" if job uses both
5. **Tool Names**: Use official names ("PostgreSQL" not "Postgres")

## ATS Scoring Breakdown

| Factor | Weight | Description |
|--------|--------|-------------|
| Keyword Match | 40% | Job keywords appear in CV |
| Skills Coverage | 30% | Required skills present |
| Format Compliance | 20% | Clean, parseable structure |
| Section Completeness | 10% | All expected sections exist |

## Target Score: ≥ 80/100

## One-Page Enforcement (MANDATORY)

### Content Limits
- **Maximum characters**: 3800
- **Maximum bullets**: 9 total (3 per experience)
- **Summary**: 280-340 characters
- **Skills**: 15-20 maximum

### Page Estimation
```
Header (200) + Summary (300) + Skills (240) + 
Experience (bullets × 90) + Education (60) = Total

Target: ≤ 3800 characters
```

### Trimming Priority (When Exceeding)
1. Remove oldest experiences (3+ years ago)
2. Reduce to 2 projects maximum
3. Keep 2-3 most relevant certifications
4. Remove hobbies, references

## Section Structure

```
1. Header (Name, Role, Contact)
2. Professional Summary
3. Skills (grouped by category)
4. Experience (reverse chronological)
5. Education
6. Projects (optional, if space)
```

## Pre-Submission Checklist

- [ ] One page exactly
- [ ] No ATS-unsafe formatting
- [ ] All bullets start with action verbs
- [ ] Job keywords distributed throughout
- [ ] Contact info complete
- [ ] Consistent date formatting
- [ ] No typos
